rule: A freight search may run only when the named registered gap has status ACTIVE_SEARCH, search_allowed=true, and the requested trigger is allowlisted. All other gaps require customer data, diligence, or internal engineering rather than repository hunting.

gaps.title: First authorized frozen buyer population through realized settlement
gaps.commercial_effect: Blocks proof of willingness to pay, incremental incumbent miss, realized recovery, and annual conversion.
gaps.stop_condition: One buyer population completes the blind protocol through settlement.

gaps.title: Trenova hosted/SaaS and change-of-control scope
gaps.commercial_effect: Blocks representing the current separately licensed Trenova revision as cleared for hosted annual deployment or transferable acquisition.
evidence_to_close: executed license/permission text confirming hosted/SaaS rights
gaps.stop_condition: Rights registry is updated from actual executed permission documents.

gaps.title: Opstrax hosted/SaaS and transferability scope
gaps.commercial_effect: Creates buyer/acquirer discount if the physical-evidence plane depends on a non-transferable or narrow permission.
gaps.stop_condition: Rights registry records documented scope rather than inference.

gaps.title: Tenant and business-unit isolation negative tests
gaps.commercial_effect: Blocks use of confidential multi-customer data in a shared production service.
evidence_to_close: tenant/BU scope enforced at repository/service boundary
audit logs for denied cross-scope attempts
gaps.stop_condition: Isolation tests pass in the actual pilot data service.

gaps.title: Hostile document/parser isolation and resource limits
gaps.commercial_effect: Blocks safely accepting arbitrary buyer PDF/XML/EDI/CSV files at scale.
gaps.stop_condition: Hostile-input negative suite passes in the deployed parsing path.

gaps.title: Canonical reproducible freight artifact, SBOM, and signed provenance
gaps.commercial_effect: Reduces buyer/acquirer confidence because chat/sandbox artifacts are not a reproducible product release.
evidence_to_close: signed release or equivalent controlled attestation
gaps.stop_condition: A canonical artifact can be reproduced from a pinned source commit and verified independently.

gaps.title: Buyer-specific external accessorial/addendum authority connector
gaps.commercial_effect: May block a specific paid pilot if its controlling addendum/tariff cannot be acquired or normalized by existing paths.
gaps.stop_condition: Activate only after a real pilot supplies a concrete source the current stack cannot ingest.

gaps.title: Buyer-specific settlement/remittance readback connector
gaps.commercial_effect: May block proof of realized recovery for a specific buyer payment/provider stack.
gaps.stop_condition: Activate only after a real pilot identifies an unsupported settlement source.

gaps.title: Independent falsifier for a concrete production disagreement
gaps.commercial_effect: Used only when existing independent comparators materially disagree on a money-bearing case.
evidence_to_close: documented disagreement between current independent engines
gaps.stop_condition: Activate only for a reproduced disagreement; stop when one independent test resolves or bounds it.
